report_discrepancies.note: Combining nonmajor Total column prints TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 2,699,237, but its lines add to 2,913,378 (the 214,141 capital outlay is left out); the governmental funds statement p4 prints the nonmajor total 2,913,378. Its Excess (deficiency) line (251,865) follows the wrong total, while Net Change 52,912 uses the correct one.
Combining nonmajor Total column prints TOTAL FUND BALANCES 4,395,748; the classification lines add to 4,395,751, which is the printed FUND BALANCES - ENDING.

The report's combining statement (report pp30-35) has no columns for the Aging Services, Drug Law Enforcement and Education, and Attorney Federal Treasury Drug Law Enforcement funds (report pages 31 and 32 are consecutive), although its Total Nonmajor column includes them; their detail is taken from the budget schedule p11 (total receipts/disbursements only).

notes: Cash basis. Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Fund balances are cash basis fund balances (cash + investments); ending cash and investments printed separately on p3; beginning cash not printed separately. Taxes 11,756,088 split by fund name: Inheritance Fund 1,824,336 inheritance tax; Visitors Promotion and Visitors Improvement funds 30,958 each lodging tax; the rest (General, Justice Center Debt Service, E911, 911 Wireless Service) has no printed tax type and stays taxes (911 funds: no surcharge note in the trim). Miscellaneous 2,202,552 split per the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): Health Insurance Settlements 1,899,231 + Miscellaneous 303,321. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement Total column (p3), whose totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General Fund from its budget schedule (p5, departments with no object breakdown); other major funds: receipts, the one-line DISBURSEMENTS total and transfers from the budget schedules (pp6-8, with budgets), as in FY2024 (fund statement columns p4 not used for detail); nonmajor funds from the combining statement fund columns (pp15-20) and, for the three funds without a combining column, from the budget schedules (p11). Funds with no activity (Veterans' Aid, Road Grant, E911 Grant) have no lines. Nonmajor budget schedules (pp9-14) otherwise duplicate the combining columns and are not recorded. Read pages 1-20 of 20
